description: HFR-NATIVE-60FPS-FULLRES-1: the native-HFR arm (playbackConform off, MLVAPP_PLAYBACK_CONFORM=0) on the 59.94 fps clip M16-1457 (by id only; 1667 frames, 27.8 s at its own rate, so it meets max(20 s, 25 s window); M16-1456 is 16.2 s native and is never a native leg). Capture-free speed legs, cuda, scale 1, Look Assist Cinematic: the full screen and windowed acceptance cells. r28 (adversary A3 on 4201a437): a leg set is one matrix with one leg per cell, so the levers that share the full screen s1 cell each have their own set: hfr-native-m16-1457-nola (Look Assist off), hfr-native-m16-1457-la3 (lookahead 3) and hfr-native-m16-1457-heavy (the HEAVY stage-attribution leg, never counted for pacing).
